breakdown.title: The Underwater School
breakdown.logline: A dreamer swims through their flooded primary school, where a teacher turns into an octopus and fish pupils flee at the sound of a bell.

colours.value: blue and green, murky, wobbly light

light.value: wobbly beams coming down from above, like looking through a dirty fish tank

texture.value: underwater, with particles and gentle currents

breakdown.world_logic: The school is underwater and everyone can breathe; a teacher can become an octopus; a school bell sounds as a stream of bubbles; fish are pupils.

style_options.name: a grainy cyanotype print
style_options.line: like a blueprint of a memory, stark and ghostly
style_options.lighting_rules: Light appears to come from above as if filtered through water, forming dim, wavering bands. Shadows are deep and blue, and edges remain crisp but dark. Everything is rendered in monochrome blue, even normally bright areas.

style_options.name: soft chalk pastel on textured paper
style_options.medium: soft chalk pastel on textured paper
style_options.dream: forms are blurred at the edges, as if remembered through the weight of water
style_options.line: gently smudged and muted, like looking through frosted glass
style_options.lighting_rules: Light is diffuse and seems to come from all directions, softening shadows and blurring outlines. Edges are slightly smudged, and colours are muted, as if seen through a veil. The atmosphere is calm and dreamy, with no harsh highlights.

style_options.name: an inked illustration with watercolour washes
style_options.medium: ink pen and watercolour on watercolour paper
style_options.line: crisp lines hold the world together as colours swirl and seep
style_options.lighting_rules: Light is painted in translucent washes, often overlapping and spreading beyond the ink outlines. Shadows are created by layering colour, softening gradually, and edges are defined by the ink lines but softened by the bleeding colours. The overall feel is fluid, as if the scene could dissolve.

style_options.name: a photograph
style_options.line: as clear as a memory you could reach into, yet moving with the water
style_options.lighting_rules: Shadows are soft and blurred, shifting slightly with the water movement. Edges are mostly crisp but slightly refracted by the water, and the overall colour leans to blue-green. Highlights shimmer and dance.

m1.text: Seen from behind the dreamer, camera at the height of the dreamer's eyes, using a 24mm lens, looking toward the far end of the underwater corridor. In the foreground, only water. In the middle distance, the dreamer is centered, seen from behind, their whole body filling the vertical space from one-third down from the top to two-thirds down. In the background, the far end of the corridor. Nobody else is in the shot. Soft underwater light comes from off to the right, where the corridor with wobbly light beams lies just outside the frame. Off to the right, just outside the picture, the continuation of the corridor with wobbly beams of light.
m1.view: Seen from behind the dreamer, from across the place, at the height of the dreamer's eyes: the camera looks toward the far end. A 24mm lens. From left to right across the picture: the dreamer, the middle of the picture, their back to the camera, seen whole and filling the picture from a third of the way down to two thirds of the way down. Nobody else is in the picture. Outside the picture, off to the right: the corridor with wobbly light. In the middle of the picture: the far end, the front of the place.

m2.view: Seen from in front of the dreamer, about 2 metres off, at the height of the dreamer's eyes: the camera looks at the doorway, toward the back of the room. A 35mm lens. From left to right across the picture: the dreamer, the middle of the picture, facing the camera, seen from the knees up and filling the picture from near its top to its bottom edge. Nobody else is in the picture. Also in the picture: the doorway, the middle of the picture, filling the picture from its top edge to its bottom edge, partly hidden behind the dreamer. Outside the picture, behind the camera: the board. Outside the picture, off to the right: the window. Outside the picture, behind the camera: the desks. Outside the picture, behind the camera: the board at the front.
reasons: the camera is or is not the dreamer's eyes wrongly, or what the moment looks at is behind it or off to one side (0.36)

shot.text: The camera is positioned 4 metres behind the dreamer, at the dreamer's eye height, looking straight ahead down the corridor; use a 24mm lens. The dreamer appears in the center of the frame, seen from behind and whole, occupying the vertical middle between one-third and two-thirds of the picture height; their back is turned to the camera, and no one else is present. Beyond the dreamer, in the middle distance, the corridor walls, floor, and ceiling recede toward the far end, which sits in the center of the background. Wobbly columns of light filter down through the water from above, creating shifting beams that surround the dreamer and wash over the corridor surfaces. The entire image has the texture of paint on dirty glass, softening edges and giving a hazy, subdued underwater look.
